Description: AWS Hands-on Labs Phases 04-06 (8 modules): pre-provisions IAM, DynamoDB tables, Lambda functions, API Gateway v1 stages, CloudWatch alarm, seed data and Lambda test events.

ArtifactBucket.Description: S3 bucket (us-east-1) holding functions/<FunctionName>.zip, seed/<TableName>.json and events/<FunctionName>.json. Leave empty to deploy placeholder code and skip seeding/test events.

ArtifactPrefix.Description: Key prefix inside ArtifactBucket, ending with '/'

AppHandler.Description: Handler for the lab application zips

AppRuntime.Description: Python runtime for the lab application functions

BedrockModelId.Description: Bedrock model / inference profile used by the agents (Nova 2 Lite US geo profile)

CostCentre.Description: Value of the cost-centre tag on AIGovernanceGateway (Phase 06-02)

CustomerDataEncryption.Description: Phase 06-01 CustomerProfiles/ErasureLedger encryption: KMS = AWS managed key aws/dynamodb (needs kms:DescribeKey/CreateGrant for the deploying identity), AWS_OWNED = DynamoDB default AWS-owned key

DailyCostAlarmThreshold.Description: AI-Daily-Cost-High threshold in USD per day

Assertions.AssertDescription: This lab must be deployed in us-east-1.

Properties.Description: Execution role shared by all lab application functions and lab setup helpers (Phases 04-06)
Assumed by TenantSaaSApp with a tenant-scoped session policy (Phase 05-01)

Properties.Name: PrairieGoods-ConfluenceAPI
Properties.Description: Phase 04-02 mock Confluence REST API (proxy to PrairieGoods-ConfluenceAPI)

Properties.Name: MeridianKB-ConfluenceAPI
Properties.Description: Phase 04-03 mock Confluence REST API (proxy to MeridianKB-ConfluenceAPI)

Properties.AlarmDescription: Phase 06-02: daily estimated AI model cost published by AIGovernanceGateway exceeds the threshold
